messages:
Maya Patel: quick follow-up from the postmortem — want to capture action owners for the streaming partial-frame / socket-resume issues we saw last week. I'll kick things off with a proposed checklist.

Anil Rao: thanks — can you paste the checklist here? want to make sure infra items are covered.

Maya Patel: short version: 1) telemetry enrichment so we can correlate partial chunks to client SDK version; 2) server-side timeout audit and a small increase for long-tail sessions; 3) SDK backoff/jitter tuning and a forced reconnect handshake patch; 4) deploy guarded circuit for the small-batch path; 5) run 72h soak with simulated intermittent drops and capture per-token traces.

Olivia Chen: +1 on telemetry. current traces drop on the gateway boundary. propose adding a "stream_chunk_id" and client_semver tag to the span. that should make queries fast. owner: Olivia. ETA: Thu 3/26.

Jun Park: I'll own the server timeout audit and config change. start by reviewing per-route timeout metrics and the 95/99th. target: find routes hitting >2s queue latency and decide if upstream cancel policy is too aggressive. owner: Jun. ETA: Mon 3/30.

Tariq Ahmed: SDK patch: I can push 0.12.3 with jittered exponential backoff (2-8s), and add a graceful resume handshake that replays last acked offset. need product signoff for protocol change. owner: Tariq. ETA: Fri 3/27.

Maya Patel: deploy guard: create a canary pipeline that routes 5% traffic to the small-batch kernel with an automatic rollback when client partials > 0.5% over 10m. owner: Anil. ETA: Wed 3/25.

Anil Rao: noted. infra plan: add a metric "partial_response_ratio" at the gateway and alert on sustained increase. I'll wire into the rollout pipeline and make the rollback policy enforced. Also will add an RBAC flag so Dedicated customers can opt out.

Olivia Chen: for telemetry sink, prefer Kafka topic "stream-partial-events" with TTL 7d and avro schema v2. I'll publish the schema and a query example.

Maya Patel: test plan: Jun/Tariq/Olivia to run a 72h soak. steps: a) run intermittent disconnects with 8-20% drop pattern; b) validate SDK resumes with no duplicate tokens; c) verify traces include stream_chunk_id and client_semver; d) ensure rollback triggers as expected. owner: cross-team. start window: Mon 3/30 -> Wed 4/1.

Tariq Ahmed: note on duplicates: adding acked-offset replay introduces a risk of repeated tokens if gateway ack isn't durable. plan: include idempotency token per chunk. SDK will surface a header `X-Stream-Chunk-Id`. I'll update doc.

Jun Park: timeout tuning note: for long sessions (>60s) we'll increase server-side per-call idle timeout from 10s -> 20s, but keep overall hard limit at 5m. set on a per-route basis. I will run load tests before rollout.

Maya Patel: risk register entry: if we increase idle timeout we may see slightly higher concurrency peaks. mitigation: add autoscale rule to bump workers when avg concurrent per-worker > threshold. owner: Anil.

Anil Rao: creating a short KB: "Handling partial streaming responses" with owner links and one-click runbook. ETA: Tue 3/24. I'll put a stub in the runbook repo and link in this thread.

Olivia Chen: ops checklist for post-deploy: 1) monitor partial_response_ratio, 2) check kafka topic consumer lag, 3) sample traces for missing stream_chunk_id. I'll add Grafana panels.

Maya Patel: PAR-level action item summary (for the ticket):
- telemetry tags + kafka sink (Olivia) — ETA 3/26
- SDK resume + idempotency header (Tariq) — ETA 3/27
- server timeout audit + staged increase (Jun) — ETA 3/30
- canary + rollback enforcement (Anil) — ETA 3/25
- 72h soak + acceptance (cross-team) — window 3/30-4/1

Maya Patel: can everyone ack ownership and confirm ETAs? I'll add these to the postmortem follow-up ticket and set weekly check-ins until closed. :white_check_mark:

Olivia Chen: acked.

Tariq Ahmed: acked. Will open SDK PR today and tag reviewers.

Jun Park: acked. will drop a link to timeout audit doc by EOD Monday.

Anil Rao: acked. will put the rollback policy into CI and link the canary pipeline.

deploy-bot: Deployment window created: canary pipeline for small-batch kernel scheduled 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z (5% traffic). Rollback policy: partial_response_ratio > 0.5% sustained 10m -> automatic rollback.

Maya Patel: thanks all. I'll update the ticket and schedule the first follow-up sync for next Tue. If anyone hits blockers ping me in #eng-sre.
